The RGB24 fixture is a 160×90 downsample of one frame from Intel IoT DevKit’s head-turn sample. It exercises both face models and the inverse crop transform on a landscape frame containing two people. [Source video](https://github.com/intel-iot-devkit/sample-videos/blob/master/head-pose-face-detection-female-and-male.mp4) · [CC BY 4.0 license](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
